mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 1.0% compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring specific triggering conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 1.0% (2-year rolling window IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.3 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market health, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced consumer spending confidence.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE rises > 0.3pp (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) indicate broad economic contraction, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: High inflation (CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.5%) during monetary tightening cycles triggers Fed policy responses that compress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL yoy > 2.5% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly retail sales decline exceeding 0.5% (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate earnings growth expectations.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when RSAFS falls > 0.5% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS > 100k) consistently drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days by accelerating corporate revenue growth and earnings expansion.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100k (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Housing market contraction (HOUST decline) combined with rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS rise) signals monetary policy tightening impacting consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST declines and FEDFUNDS rises (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production below 100 (INDPRO < 100) during supply-constrained periods indicates manufacturing slowdown, compressing corporate margins and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100 (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).
